goal: Generate a new pose variation using the provided base_reference image as the complete source of truth for identity, dress, styling, background, and lighting. Only the pose should change while everything else remains identical.

priority_rules.explicit_rule: Preserve EVERYTHING from base_reference except the pose. No changes allowed to identity, dress, accessories, background, or lighting.

subject.instruction: Use base_reference as the complete identity source. Face, skin tone, features, and proportions must remain identical. No identity drift or beautification changes.
subject.hair: Keep hair exactly the same as base_reference. No change in style, direction, or volume.
subject.makeup: Keep makeup identical to base_reference. No enhancement or style change.
subject.expression: Maintain same expression unless minor natural adjustment is required for pose realism.

body.pose_instruction: SOFT FEMININE POSE, model gently holding sides of the dress to highlight fabric and print, slight downward glance, relaxed shoulders, elegant natural feel
body.consistency_rule: Body proportions and presence must remain identical to base_reference.

wardrobe_and_accessories.dress: Preserve EXACT same dress from base_reference. No change in design, fit, fabric, folds, or print.
wardrobe_and_accessories.accessories: Keep accessories exactly the same. Do not add, remove, or modify.
wardrobe_and_accessories.footwear: Keep same footwear exactly with correct perspective.

pose_and_composition.pose_change: ONLY pose should change as defined in pose_instruction.
pose_and_composition.camera_angle: Maintain same camera angle and lens feel as base_reference.
pose_and_composition.framing: Keep same framing style. Minor adjustment allowed only if required for pose realism.
pose_and_composition.proportions: Subject scale and placement must match base_reference.

environment_and_lighting.background: Preserve exact same background and environment.
environment_and_lighting.lighting: Keep lighting identical (direction, softness, exposure, color).
environment_and_lighting.shadows: Maintain consistent shadow logic with the new pose.

technical_preferences.exposure_instruction: Match base_reference exactly with consistent brightness and tone
